title: Essence
kicker: Stocks and economy · summon and fusion
loopLine: Summon and fusion · Farm / hunt / defend
hook: **Essence** is element-matched material you stockpile for fusion (and for some buildings later) — fire essence is not the same as ice essence.

blindSpots.meaning: A **material stock** in your save, split by element. Not souls, not loam, not a demon’s health.
A fusion that wants fire essence will not take ice essence instead. The colour (element) is the point of the bottleneck.
Essence stays with your summoner across worlds — same idea as souls. [Loam](loam) does not.
Merging specimens in the Fusion lab (`F`). That is the main place you spend essence today.

alsoTrue: Essence is one of three stocks. The others are [souls](souls) and [loam](loam). They do not convert into each other.
You may also see **shards** as fusion materials. Shards are rarity-matched fodder; essence is the element gate. This page is about essence.

sections.title: What it is
paras: Six colours of stock — fire, ice, air, earth, light, dark — matching the combat elements.
You earn them by playing. You spend them when a fusion (or later a building) asks for a specific colour.
sections.note: Essence banks across worlds — see [New world](new-world-prestige).

sections.title: Why it exists
paras: If every merge cost the same generic currency, element would stop mattering the moment you left combat.
Essence keeps the ring honest in the workshop: the result’s element asks for matching material, so farming and planning stay elemental.

sections.title: How it works
sections.intro: Think of faucets and sinks — same shape as souls, different wallet:

cards.name: Faucets
cards.body: Lawn play, expedition returns, and map work can pay essence (and related materials).

cards.name: Sinks
cards.body: Specimen fusion spends the colour the recipe asks for. Some sector buildings later also ask for essence.

groups.title: In the control room
groups.intro: Materials show up where fusion and expeditions care about them.
steps: Open Fusion (`F`) and read the cost panel — have / need for the essence colour.
Open Expeditions and check materials after a return — drops include essences.
On the HUD stock strip, essence sits beside souls as a stock you can bank.
groups.note: Exact drop amounts change with balance. Trust the have/need numbers on screen.

doSteps: Finish a lawn match or collect an expedition that can pay materials.
Open Fusion (`F`) with a merge in mind.
Read the cost panel: if essence is short, note the **colour** you need — then farm that colour, not a different one.
doNote: Stop here when you can tell fire essence from ice essence. Next: how merges work in [specimen fusion](specimen-fusion).

mixUps.q: Can I convert fire essence into ice?
mixUps.a: No. Colours do not swap. That bottleneck is intentional.

mixUps.q: Is essence the same as souls?
mixUps.a: No. Souls buy summons and keep pacts. Essence feeds fusion’s element gate. See [souls](souls).

mixUps.q: Does essence fade if I neglect the map?
mixUps.a: No. Only [loam](loam) fades with neglected ground. Essence banks.

mixUps.q: Do I need essence to pull at the altar?
mixUps.a: No. The altar spends souls. Essence shows up when you fuse.
No. Shards are another fusion material (rarity fodder). Essence is the element-matched stock.
